# Bruce's Lawn and Tree Care

> Tree, lawn & snow service based in Bloomington, Indiana. Tree removal, bucket-truck trimming, stump grinding and mowing around Bloomington, plus plowing and de-icing when winter hits. Customers call the crew friendly, professional and reasonable.

- Phone: (812) 327-9293
- Based in: Bloomington, IN
- Service area: Bloomington, Ellettsville, Spencer, Bedford, Martinsville, Nashville
- Google rating: 3.7 from 6 reviews
- Request an estimate: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/tree-service/indiana/bruce-s-lawn-and-tree-care/quote.html
- Book a visit: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/tree-service/indiana/bruce-s-lawn-and-tree-care/book.html

## Services
- Tree removal: Big oaks and hardwoods beside houses and garages, taken down limb by limb so nothing lands where it shouldn't. Storm damage too.
- Bucket-truck trimming: Our Lift-All bucket trucks put the saw right where the cut needs to be, high over the house, the lines or the parking lot.
- Stump grinding & lot clearing: Stumps ground down with a Rayco grinder, or the skid-steer grinder for the big ones. Wooded lots cleared so you can build, mow or plant.
- Mowing & landscaping: The lawn side of Bruce's Lawn and Tree Care: regular mowing and trimming, plus landscaping and grading jobs.
- Snow removal & de-icing: A line of plow trucks with red Western plows and a liquid de-icing rig for lots and drives when the snow comes.
- Dumpster rental & mulch: A roll-off dumpster for yard cleanups and projects, and mulch delivered to your place.

## About
Bruce's Lawn and Tree Care works out of the west side of Bloomington, on W Vernal Pike. Dustin and the crew handle the jobs most people don't want to touch: big oaks leaning over a roof, pines up against the power lines, storm limbs across a house, stumps the size of a kitchen table. The trucks say it plainly: insured, free estimates. In the warm months that means bucket trucks, stump grinders, a skid steer and the mowers. When the snow comes, the plows and the de-icing rig go out. We work Bloomington, Ellettsville, Spencer, Bedford, Martinsville and the towns around them across Monroe, Owen, Lawrence and Morgan Counties. Our goal is simple: professional results and good customer service. Customers say the price is reasonable and the crew is friendly, and one said half the neighborhood came out to watch the bucket truck work.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Can you take down a big tree right next to my house?
  A: Yes. That's a lot of what we do. We use the bucket truck to take big trees down limb by limb so the pieces land in the yard, not on the roof.
- Q: A storm put a tree on my house. Can you come now?
  A: Call (812) 327-9293. We take emergency calls, and trees on a house or blocking a drive get handled first.
- Q: Are you insured?
  A: Yes. Bruce's Lawn and Tree Care is insured, and it's lettered right on the trucks.
- Q: Do you give free estimates?
  A: Yes. Call (812) 327-9293 or send the details online and we'll come look at the tree.
- Q: Do you grind stumps and clear lots?
  A: Yes. We grind stumps with a Rayco grinder, and a skid-steer grinder for the big ones. We also clear wooded lots.
- Q: Do you still do lawn care?
  A: Yes. Mowing, trimming and landscaping are still part of what we do. Call and tell us about your yard.
- Q: Do you plow and de-ice parking lots?
  A: Yes. In winter we run plow trucks and a liquid de-icing rig for lots, complexes, businesses and drives, and we keep salt on hand.
- Q: What areas do you serve?
  A: Bloomington, Ellettsville, Spencer, Bedford, Martinsville, Nashville, Solsberry, Unionville, Heltonville, Dolan and the areas around them: Monroe, Owen, Lawrence and Morgan Counties.
- Q: Do you rent dumpsters?
  A: Yes. We have a roll-off dumpster for cleanups and projects, and we deliver mulch.
- Q: Are you hiring?
  A: Yes. We're looking for a ground labor operator. Call (812) 327-9293 or message us on Facebook.
